h33-h33-2-b2-BREAKLINEf33breakline-20261.hypothesis: Quaternary fault scarps express in detrended topography as LINEAR breaks-in-slope (||grad det_elev_slope|| ridges with high structure-tensor coherence of det_elev). Faults that juxtapose like lithologies or offset only alluvium have a scarp but no magnetic/gravity contrast, so the H19-5 potential-field worm skeleton -- and with it parent R0 and the Qfaults-based catalogue built largely from mappable scarps on older imagery -- misses or misplaces them, while expert mapping on high-resolution DEMs (the competition label source, DrivenData #306 p.967) traces exactly such breaks. Placing 33-45% of the fixed budget on coherent slope-break ridges >3px off the worm skeleton, and keeping only coverage-nonredundant skeleton dots under the same field, raises expected kernel credit per dot versus R0's unranked geometric thinning.
h33-h33-2-b2-BREAKLINEf33breakline-20261.mechanism: At fixed S=37,654, DTI rises when expected T gains outweigh denominator growth. Dots are emitted by exact marginal expected-DTI greedy (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, triangular R=3px) under w=0.30+0.70*L on support (H19-5 for keeps, H19-5 + far-ridge for arrivals) and 0.08*L off support -- so a candidate is only taken while its uncovered expected lineament mass exceeds the running bar, which also enforces kernel-scale non-redundancy along each break line without an ad-hoc spacing rule.
h33-h33-2-b2-BREAKLINEf33breakline-20261.non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline terraces, alluvial-fan segment boundaries and terrace risers, bedding-plane breaks on dipping volcanic strata, and incised-drainage valley walls all produce linear, coherent slope breaks with no Quaternary surface rupture. Far dots concentrated on a shoreline bench would be pure false positives.
h33-h33-2-b2-BREAKLINEf33breakline-20261.falsifier: Live receipt delta <= -0.010 vs R0 rejects off-worm topographic breaks as new-fault locations at these doses (either the expert labels follow potential-field geometry after all, or 100 m topographic breaks are dominated by erosional mimics). A holdout delta at or below R0 with CI excluding 0 likewise rejects the lane on the catalogue instrument. |delta| < 0.01 live is no evidence (public-chunk noise).
